todos: [P1] OLLAMA-THINKING-PREFERENCE-01: add a sanitized per-model thinking preference to AppSettings, defaulting to disabled when absent; resolve exact installed-model aliases and derive binary toggle eligibility from Ollama-reported capabilities/model facts, failing closed for unsupported, unknown, and level-only models such as GPT-OSS. Add focused domain and settings persistence tests, then update docs/agent.md.

[P1] OLLAMA-THINKING-UI-01: add an on/off Thinking control to each installed model card only when the resolved model supports a true binary choice; show the effective disabled default, preserve independent preferences per model, and expose an explicit compatibility note instead of a misleading switch for always-on or level-only models. Add component/interaction coverage and update the settings documentation.

[P1] OLLAMA-THINKING-RUNTIME-01: propagate the effective per-model thinking choice through typed IPC and every applicable Ollama text-generation path, including chat, Agent Coding interview, plan generation, streamed agent turns, translation, and LLM normalization; send top-level think:false by default, send think:true only for an eligible enabled model, keep thinking traces separate from final content, and prevent thinking tokens from corrupting structured JSON or tool-call parsing. Add transport, application, IPC, sidecar, and regression tests, then update docs/agent.md.

[P1] OLLAMA-THINKING-VERIFICATION-01: run targeted tests plus typecheck, static quality, docs check, fast suite, build, audit, Electron Agent E2E, and live Ollama probes for a toggleable thinking model in both states; verify default-off persistence and confirm unsupported/level-only models cannot present a false disabled state. Record any runtime-specific residue in this tracker and update AGENTS.md only with commands and counts verified in the session.

[P2] CODING-AGENT-DEBUG-PAYLOAD-UI-01: integrate the sensitive payload opt-in into the Log Debug Coding Agent control as a clearly subordinate option; keep it hidden or disabled while the parent log is off, make the effective runtime value false whenever logging is disabled without unnecessarily erasing the saved preference, clarify that it affects only Coding Agent audit logs and diagnostic bundles, and retain metadata-only logging as the default. Add settings interaction, sanitization/runtime gating, and debug-bundle regression tests, then update docs/agent.md and the localized labels.
